A brilliantly vivid splash of colours and a wildly fun composed by the Raati fame featuring the most exciting cast one could ask for! Is there a better way to head into the weekend? , the current darling of Tamil Television features alongside the stunningly beautiful in this groovy music video directed by and choreographed by . Watch it here and bring out the moves !

Composed by - Santhosh Dhayanidhi
Featuring - Ashwin Kumar, Reba Monica John
Sung by - Santhosh Dhayanidhi, Rakshita Suresh
Lyrics - A.Pa Raja
Directed by - Venki
Cinematography - Harish Kannan
